title: 足踏み操作器付き電動ろくろ
description: 陶芸教室・交流施設の制作室に置く電動ろくろ外観。回転円盤と細い同心ガイド、内側が実際に開いた飛沫受け鉢、主軸外装、駆動筐体と通気表現、四脚、ケーブルで繋がる足踏み操作器を造形。粘土・器・椅子は含まず、ペダルは本体と合わせて一式1点です。回転・速度制御・電装や実用品性能は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.743 × 0.788 × 0.918 m、10,476三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An electric pottery-wheel appearance prop for ceramics classes and community studios. It has a throwing disk with fine concentric guides, genuinely open splash basin, spindle exterior, drive enclosure/vent details, four legs and a cable-connected foot controller. Clay, pottery and stool are absent; the included pedal is part of one assembly. Rotation, speed control, electrical operation and real-equipment performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.743 × 0.788 × 0.918 m; 10,476 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
